AI Overview
Enfosi is a Roblox wave defense game where you play as different species of Glaggles to protect the central Glaggle statue from corrupted, zombie-like enemies called Infosians. 
YouTube
·Fishmetal
 +2
Core Objective and Rules
Protect the Statue: Your primary goal is to keep the Glaggle statue from being destroyed by Infosians.
Identify Enemies: Do not attack everyone who approaches. Most incoming creatures are friendly Glaggles who celebrate when they reach the statue; only attack the corrupted Infosians.
Strikes: Killing a friendly Glaggle or dying gives you a strike. Getting 3 strikes turns you into a "hollow worthless sober" for the rest of the round.
Rankings: You earn a higher rank (up to G rank) by keeping collective strikes low and ending with high statue HP. 
Starting Classes
You can choose from different Glaggle classes, each with unique loadouts and perks: 
YouTube
·Profie02
 +1
Giggler: The default all-rounder starter class. Can sell starting and shop weapons for their full coin price.
Gazo: Specialized for long-range combat.
Glubber: Acts as a healer and support class.
Jumbo Jimbo Jambo: Focuses on explosive and Area-of-Effect (AoE) damage.
Cheer: Spawns with traps used to detect Infosians.
Glebler: A fast, recon-focused class.
Glabber: The tank class. 
YouTube
·Profie02
 +2
Economy and Gear
Coins (Bintar): Earned by completing waves (Wave 1 gives no coins). You use coins in the shop between rounds to buy new weapons or items from any class.
Ammo & Healing: Use blue lockers or toss resupply stations to refill ammo. Use green glowing smiley-face health pads to restore 300 health.
